subject: RetailGrid inbound: quick fit questions before demo
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@retailgrid.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@retailgrid.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request — RetailGrid (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Kimberly,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve yesterday and ran a couple quick tests. Early signals look promising for a search & product discovery use case at RetailGrid — we index product metadata + UGC and want to layer LLM completion for intent rewriting + ranking signals.

Before we schedule a demo, can your team confirm which model families are typically recommended for a high-throughput product search integration (latency under 150ms preferred) and whether you support prefix/KV caching for product embeddings?

TL;DR: We want a short demo this week to walk through architecture and cost tradeoffs. Our team is on Pacific time. Possible attendees: myself (eng), our infra lead (cc'd), and our PM.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Product Engineering | RetailGrid
samir@retailgrid.com

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — RetailGrid (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Samir — great to meet you and welcome aboard.

Quick clarifying questions so our demo is tightly scoped (short 30–40m session):
- Primary objective: intent rewriting + candidate rerank (yes / no)?
- Expected QPS and peak concurrent requests (e.g., 50 QPS steady, 250 peak)?
- Index size / document count (approx # of product SKUs + UGC records)?
- Timeline: pilot/POC target date and production launch window?
- Any data residency or VPC requirements we should account for?

We typically recommend a family tuned for low-latency completions with KV cache enabled for product prefixes; Ben (cc) will bring throughput guidance.

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Mon 5/24 10:00–10:40
- Tue 5/25 14:00–14:40
- Wed 5/26 09:00–09:40

If none of those work, tell us a couple slots and your timezone and we’ll match. I attached a short intake form — if you can fill the highlighted fields it speeds things up.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
(Attachment: retailgrid-intake-form.pdf)
From: Samir Gupta <samir@retailgrid.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@retailgrid.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — RetailGrid (self-serve sign-up)

Thanks Kimberly — answers inline below.

- Primary objective: Yes — intent rewrite -> rerank pipeline. We also may use short generative snippets for product descriptions in a second phase.
- QPS: baseline ~40 QPS, peak ~220 QPS during promos. Concurrency ~50 concurrent inference streams.
- Index size: ~2.1M product + UGC documents; average doc length small (product metadata), embeddings stored per SKU.
- Timeline: Pilot kickoff in ~5–6 weeks, production roll early next quarter.
- Data residency: US only; no VPC required for pilot.

Slots: Mon 5/24 at 10:00 PT works for our PM and eng.

Attaching a short SSR / security notes doc and our initial traffic profile (csv). Let us know if you need SSO / SCIM info ahead of time.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Product Engineering | RetailGrid
(Attachments: retailgrid-ssr-requirements.pdf, retailgrid-traffic-202705.csv)

Thanks Samir — Monday 5/24 10:00 PT is locked. I just sent a calendar invite (rg-demo-invite.ics) to the attendees. A couple quick notes so we can prepare: 
- We’ll demo a low-latency rerank path (KV cache + batching) and show cost estimates for your QPS profile.
- Monica will bring best-practice questions for indexing/embedding density given ~2M docs.
- If you can share a representative example query and a couple product SKUs before the call (redacted is fine), we can build a short, live comparison.

Next steps for you: upload one sample query + SKU list to the shared drive link below before EOD Friday so our eng demo can include real results. If anything changes on the slots I’ll reschedule — otherwise see you Monday.

Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/retailgrid-intake

Cheers,
